info.title: DekaSign integration and session API
info.description: Production APIs require an active paid plan, Production app/key, allowed scopes and enabled capabilities. Some design-management operations remain sandbox-only. Template authoring and human approval decisions are not delegated to API keys. Session routes use separate identity. This specification grants no access or capability activation.

post.description: Fetches the saved, tested template API Data Source without exposing its credentials. Body limit is 20,000 bytes, with up to 20 named lookup parameters. No invitation or signing package is created. Pass lookup_token to the signing preview within 10 minutes. Production returns only mapped supported variables and requires enabled data-source capability and current paid app authority.
